title: Modestsisters: A Shopify E-Commerce Case Study for a UAE Modest Fashion Brand
storyLead: How Teknoppy designed and developed a luxury Shopify shopping experience for Modestsisters, creating structured hierarchies for abayas and accessories, sitewide free shipping trust, and seamless Instagram support.

Free UAE shipping surfaced site-wide, not just at checkout

aboutParagraphs: Modestsisters is a UAE-based modest fashion brand selling handcrafted abayas, coord-sets, dresses, and tops, alongside jewelry and sunglasses.

Modest fashion shoppers are often browsing with a specific style already in mind — an abaya for a particular occasion, a coord-set in a certain silhouette — rather than casually scrolling a general clothing catalog. A flat, uncategorized store works against exactly this kind of shopper, forcing her to sift through everything rather than moving directly to what she came for.

Accessories add a second layer most standalone clothing brands don't have to plan for. Jewelry and sunglasses serve a genuinely different browsing intent than an abaya or coord-set, and treating them as an afterthought tacked onto the clothing catalog undersells both — a shopper looking specifically for jewelry shouldn't have to wade through dresses to find it.
challengeLead: A growing modest fashion catalog needs a structure that respects how intentionally its shoppers browse — the previous setup didn't have one:

challenges.title: No structured category hierarchy
challenges.description: Abayas, coord-sets, dresses, and tops, alongside jewelry and sunglasses, sat without a clear Clothing versus Accessories split, making it harder for shoppers to move between product types.

challenges.title: No visible shipping terms
challenges.description: Without shipping information surfaced upfront, UAE customers had to reach checkout or ask directly before knowing delivery terms — an unnecessary point of friction for a detail that should be settled before a shopper even adds an item to cart.

challenges.title: No consistent discount visibility
challenges.description: Sale pricing wasn't shown consistently across listings, making it harder for shoppers to spot current offers while browsing rather than discovering a discount only after opening a product page.

challenges.title: No support channel matching how shoppers actually engage with the brand
challenges.description: Without a direct route through the platform where modest-fashion shoppers already follow and interact with the brand, order questions and general enquiries had no clear, comfortable path.

challenges.title: Storefront experience didn't reflect the brand's positioning
challenges.description: Modestsisters positions itself around "effortless elegance and timeless luxury," but a cluttered or unclear shopping experience undercuts that positioning regardless of how well the products themselves live up to it.

objectiveLead: Teknoppy's goal was to build a Shopify store that could:
objectives: Organize a growing clothing and accessories catalog into a clear, navigable structure
Surface shipping information upfront, before checkout
Show sale pricing consistently across the catalog, not just on individual product pages
Route support through the channel shoppers already use to engage with the brand
Give the brand's "effortless elegance and timeless luxury" positioning a storefront to actually match
approachLead: How Teknoppy crafted an elegant Shopify storefront optimized for modest fashion shoppers:

approachPillars.title: Clothing and Accessories organized into structured categories
paragraphs: Abayas, Coord-Sets, Dresses, and Tops sit under Clothing; Necklaces, Rings, and Bracelets sit under Accessories; Sunglasses stands as its own category. Giving each garment type its own clear place, rather than one flat product grid, lets a shopper who already knows she wants an abaya move there directly instead of scrolling past everything else first.

approachPillars.title: Free shipping messaging surfaced site-wide
paragraphs: A persistent banner — "Free shipping within UAE on all orders" — sets delivery expectations before a customer ever reaches checkout, removing a common point of last-minute hesitation at exactly the stage where it does the most damage to a completed sale.

approachPillars.title: Consistent sale pricing display
paragraphs: Original and discounted prices are shown together across product listings, making current offers easy to spot while browsing rather than requiring a shopper to open each product individually to find out if it's discounted.

approachPillars.title: A direct Instagram support channel
paragraphs: Order support and general enquiries route to the brand's Instagram, meeting modest-fashion shoppers on the platform where they already engage with the brand — following its posts, watching new arrivals, building familiarity — rather than redirecting them to an unfamiliar contact form.

approachPillars.title: A storefront that matches the brand's positioning
paragraphs: Layout, imagery treatment, and overall pacing were built to reflect "effortless elegance and timeless luxury" as an actual browsing experience, not just a tagline sitting above a generic ecommerce template.

approachPillars.title: Mobile-first, for how modest fashion is actually browsed
paragraphs: Fashion discovery for this audience happens largely through mobile browsing, often alongside the same Instagram feed the brand uses for support. Category pages, product imagery, and checkout were built mobile-first, so the experience holds together across the same device a shopper uses to follow the brand in the first place.

deliverables.title: Clothing & Accessories Category Architecture
deliverables.description: Abayas, Coord-Sets, Dresses, and Tops structured under Clothing; Necklaces, Rings, and Bracelets structured under Accessories; Sunglasses isolated as a dedicated line.

deliverables.title: Sitewide Free Delivery Reassurance
deliverables.description: Persistent top announcement banner confirming free shipping throughout the UAE on all orders.

deliverables.title: Immediate Discount & Compare-At Pricing
deliverables.description: Real-time comparative pricing highlighting active sales directly on category listings without opening product details.

deliverables.title: Instagram Support Channel Route
deliverables.description: Direct mobile routing to the brand's Instagram profile for effortless customer styling and order inquiries.

whyMattersHeading: Why Category Clarity Matters for Modest Fashion E-Commerce
whyMattersParagraphs: Modest fashion shoppers frequently search with specific, values-driven intent — "abaya" isn't interchangeable with "dress" in either search behaviour or actual product fit, and a category structure that keeps these as clearly separated entities matters as much to a search engine matching intent as it does to a shopper who already knows exactly what she's browsing for. Lumping distinct garment types into one generic "clothing" bucket dilutes both.

Stating a concrete local shipping term — free shipping within the UAE, specifically — also functions as a real, checkable local commerce signal, the kind of specific answer both search engines and AI shopping assistants increasingly need to answer a buyer's actual question ("does this ship free to my emirate") rather than a vague general shipping policy page.

Consistent discount display plays a similar role for buying confidence. A shopper who has to open every product individually to discover whether it's discounted is more likely to abandon browsing altogether than one who can scan a category page and immediately see which pieces are on sale — a small structural decision with a real effect on how far into the catalog a visitor actually gets.

Routing support through Instagram, rather than a generic contact form, reflects how modest fashion and other visually driven D2C categories actually build trust today: through an ongoing social presence a shopper already follows, not a one-off transactional interaction. Meeting a customer in the channel where the relationship already exists tends to resolve concerns faster and with more warmth than an anonymous support ticket.
whyMattersCalloutHtml: By organizing a growing catalog into clear categories, making shipping and pricing visible before checkout, and routing support through the channel shoppers already trust, the Modestsisters storefront is built to feel as considered as the 'effortless elegance' it's selling. faqs.question: What was the main goal of the Modestsisters Shopify project?
faqs.answer: To build a store that organizes a growing modest fashion catalog into a clear structure while surfacing shipping and pricing information upfront.

faqs.question: What does Modestsisters sell?
faqs.answer: Abayas, coord-sets, dresses, and tops, alongside necklaces, rings, bracelets, and sunglasses, shipped within the UAE.

faqs.question: What platform is Modestsisters built on?
How are products organized on the site?
faqs.answer: Under two main groups — Clothing (Abayas, Coord-Sets, Dresses, Tops) and Accessories (Necklaces, Rings, Bracelets) — with Sunglasses as its own category, so shoppers can move directly to the type of product they want.

faqs.question: Is shipping free within the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes — a site-wide banner states free shipping within the UAE on all orders, shown before checkout rather than as a surprise at the final step.

faqs.question: How can I tell if an item is on sale while browsing?
faqs.answer: Original and discounted prices are shown together directly on product listings, so current offers are visible while browsing rather than only after opening an individual product.

faqs.question: How do I contact Modestsisters with a question about my order?
faqs.answer: Through the brand's Instagram, which is used as the direct support and enquiry channel — the platform where most modest-fashion shoppers already follow and engage with the brand.

faqs.question: Why does the site route support through Instagram instead of a contact form?
faqs.answer: Because it meets shoppers in the channel where they already have a relationship with the brand, rather than redirecting them to an unfamiliar form for a brand they mostly know through social content.

faqs.question: Does the site work well for browsing on a phone?
faqs.answer: Yes — category pages, product imagery, and checkout were built mobile-first, since most modest fashion browsing for this audience happens on the same device used to follow the brand on Instagram.
